title: Offline ASB end-to-end pilot harness

asb_observations.setup: benchmark inputs and deterministic case identity are observed; no benchmark is launched
asb_observations.selection: agent identity and bounded capability selection are observed without provider discovery
asb_observations.configuration: agent configuration is represented by digests and finite limits only
asb_observations.run: not_performed is mandatory; no provider, LLM, process, host, or network is contacted
asb_observations.record: supplied bounded observations are recorded by digest
asb_observations.replay: the supplied record is deterministically replayed and must be idempotent
asb_observations.comparison: supplied observations are compared by digest and bounded result, not live performance

failure_semantics.side_effects: No ASB run, provider, network, LLM, hosted CI, Coordinator, durable-state, Git, publication, or authority operation is performed.

limitations: The harness validates supplied observations only.
A passing pilot is structural offline evidence, not an ASB result, provider qualification, benchmark measurement, or live workflow success.
